title: Kiritani Haruka — The World's Best Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Haruka's Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, it should be all set up now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had no idea that an app that lets you listen to radio stations from around the country existed. I really need to thank Minori for telling me about this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, do you know the name of your hero's radio program? I really wanna listen to it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I do... But her stations are in another part of the country, and I don't think you can find it online either.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, what about an app?
It might be available there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? An app?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, this one... There's no background noise and it lets you listen to radio stations from around the country!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? I had no idea this kind of app existed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Remember how you and the others sometimes used to do radio commercials for when you went to do shows in other parts of the country?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really wanted to listen to them, so I did some research and found something that would let me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm sure this app should let you listen to your hero's radio program!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wonder what kind of program it is.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, her voice. I'm really curious as to what she sounds like now. It might've changed quite a lot since then.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's time...

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Hello, listeners!
It's time for another installment of “Smiling News Bulletin”! As usual, we'll be bringing you news from all over the region this week♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's her...!)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <It's been getting very chilly lately, so I hope you're all staying warm out there. Actually, it's been getting so cold that I've been trying to figure out a way to commute to work without leaving my kotatsu!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's still as cheerful and talkative as ever, and her voice is so nice to listen to. She still speaks like the way I remember.)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Incidentally, I was invited to appear at a fall festival that was being held within the region just the other day, and I had a chance to sing a few songs.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <The children who were there all sang and danced along with me, it was so much fun.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <My goal was to make sure everyone there enjoyed themselves, but their energy was just so infectious that I was the one filled with cheer!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She did a performance...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I'm sure she made everybody smile...
Just like she did back then.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wish I could've been there to see her perform...)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Oh, speaking of which... During that performance, something really great happened for me personally.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <One of the children who joined me on stage came up to me and said, “I wanna perform on stage just like you someday.”>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <That reminded me of a little girl who said the same thing to me when I performed at this one shopping mall in Tokyo when I was still an idol.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is she talking about...?)

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Dreams are so wonderful. They may be far in the future, but they're all beautiful because they can be whatever you want them to be.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Like a boundless ocean under a clear sky.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <And I feel blessed knowing that I'm still able to spread hope for a better tomorrow to others in that manner.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Listen to me...
I'm such a sap.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's still an incredible person...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She may not be an idol anymore, but she's still able to spread hope to others like before...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I wouldn't be an idol right now if it wasn't for her...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(No, it goes beyond that.
I wouldn't have learned how to smile if it weren't for her.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you so much...
For making me who I am.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <That's it for this week. Thirty minutes never feels like enough time, but I hope you all enjoyed the program.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: <Next week, we'll be bringing you some more fun news, so I hope you'll tune in.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line:
<Keep smiling until then.
See you next time♪>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Wow...
Thirty minutes flew by just like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (My chest is filled with so much warmth. It might be because I know that she's doing well now.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She made me believe in a better tomorrow. Again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, that means I need to also keep trying my best.
